2| * parser.c : an XML 1.0 parser, namespaces and validity support are mostly
3| *            implemented on top of the SAX interfaces
4| *
5| * References:
6| *   The XML specification:
7| *     http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-xml
8| *   Original 1.0 version:
9| *     http://www.w3.org/TR/1998/REC-xml-19980210
10| *   XML second edition working draft
11| *     http://www.w3.org/TR/2000/WD-xml-2e-20000814
12| *
13| * Okay this is a big file, the parser core is around 7000 lines, then it
14| * is followed by the progressive parser top routines, then the various
15| * high level APIs to call the parser and a few miscellaneous functions.
16| * A number of helper functions and deprecated ones have been moved to
17| * parserInternals.c to reduce this file size.
18| * As much as possible the functions are associated with their relative
19| * production in the XML specification. A few productions defining the
20| * different ranges of character are actually implanted either in
21| * parserInternals.h or parserInternals.c
22| * The DOM tree build is realized from the default SAX callbacks in
23| * the module SAX.c.
24| * The routines doing the validation checks are in valid.c and called either
25| * from the SAX callbacks or as standalone functions using a preparsed

425|static void
426|xmlSaturatedAdd(unsigned long *dst, unsigned long val) {
427|    if (val > ULONG_MAX - *dst)
428|        *dst = ULONG_MAX;
429|    else
430|        *dst += val;
431|}

433|static void
434|xmlSaturatedAddSizeT(unsigned long *dst, unsigned long val) {
435|    if (val > ULONG_MAX - *dst)
436|        *dst = ULONG_MAX;
437|    else
438|        *dst += val;
439|}

441|/**
442| * xmlParserEntityCheck:
443| * @ctxt:  parser context
444| * @extra:  sum of unexpanded entity sizes
445| *
446| * Check for non-linear entity expansion behaviour.
447| *
448| * In some cases like xmlStringDecodeEntities, this function is called
449| * for each, possibly nested entity and its unexpanded content length.
450| *
451| * In other cases like xmlParseReference, it's only called for each
452| * top-level entity with its unexpanded content length plus the sum of
453| * the unexpanded content lengths (plus fixed cost) of all nested
454| * entities.
455| *
456| * Summing the unexpanded lengths also adds the length of the reference.
457| * This is by design. Taking the length of the entity name into account
458| * discourages attacks that try to waste CPU time with abusively long
459| * entity names. See test/recurse/lol6.xml for example. Each call also
460| * adds some fixed cost XML_ENT_FIXED_COST to discourage attacks with
461| * short entities.
462| *
463| * Returns 1 on error, 0 on success.
464| */
465|static int
466|xmlParserEntityCheck(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, unsigned long extra)
467|{
468|    unsigned long consumed;
469|    xmlParserInputPtr input = ctxt->input;
470|    xmlEntityPtr entity = input->entity;
471|
472|    /*
473|     * Compute total consumed bytes so far, including input streams of
474|     * external entities.
475|     */
476|    consumed = input->parentConsumed;
477|    if ((entity == NULL) ||
478|        ((entity->etype == XML_EXTERNAL_PARAMETER_ENTITY) &&
479|         ((entity->flags & XML_ENT_PARSED) == 0))) {
480|        xmlSaturatedAdd(&consumed, input->consumed);
481|        xmlSaturatedAddSizeT(&consumed, input->cur - input->base);
482|    }
483|    xmlSaturatedAdd(&consumed, ctxt->sizeentities);
484|
485|    /*
486|     * Add extra cost and some fixed cost.
487|     */
488|    xmlSaturatedAdd(&ctxt->sizeentcopy, extra);
489|    xmlSaturatedAdd(&ctxt->sizeentcopy, XML_ENT_FIXED_COST);
490|
491|    /*
492|     * It's important to always use saturation arithmetic when tracking
493|     * entity sizes to make the size checks reliable. If "sizeentcopy"
494|     * overflows, we have to abort.
495|     */
496|    if ((ctxt->sizeentcopy > XML_PARSER_ALLOWED_EXPANSION) &&
497|        ((ctxt->sizeentcopy >= ULONG_MAX) ||
498|         (ctxt->sizeentcopy / ctxt->maxAmpl > consumed))) {
499|        xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_LOOP,
500|                       "Maximum entity amplification factor exceeded, see "
501|                       "xmlCtxtSetMaxAmplification.\n");
502|        xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
503|        return(1);
504|    }
505|
506|    return(0);
507|}

795|/**
796| * xmlAttrNormalizeSpace:
797| * @src: the source string
798| * @dst: the target string
799| *
800| * Normalize the space in non CDATA attribute values:
801| * If the attribute type is not CDATA, then the XML processor MUST further
802| * process the normalized attribute value by discarding any leading and
803| * trailing space (#x20) characters, and by replacing sequences of space
804| * (#x20) characters by a single space (#x20) character.
805| * Note that the size of dst need to be at least src, and if one doesn't need
806| * to preserve dst (and it doesn't come from a dictionary or read-only) then
807| * passing src as dst is just fine.
808| *
809| * Returns a pointer to the normalized value (dst) or NULL if no conversion
810| *         is needed.
811| */
812|static xmlChar *
813|xmlAttrNormalizeSpace(const xmlChar *src, xmlChar *dst)
814|{
815|    if ((src == NULL) || (dst == NULL))
816|        return(NULL);
817|
818|    while (*src == 0x20) src++;
819|    while (*src != 0) {
820|	if (*src == 0x20) {
821|	    while (*src == 0x20) src++;
822|	    if (*src != 0)
823|		*dst++ = 0x20;
824|	} else {
825|	    *dst++ = *src++;
826|	}
827|    }
828|    *dst = 0;
829|    if (dst == src)
830|       return(NULL);
831|    return(dst);

834|/**
835| * xmlAttrNormalizeSpace2:
836| * @src: the source string
837| *
838| * Normalize the space in non CDATA attribute values, a slightly more complex
839| * front end to avoid allocation problems when running on attribute values
840| * coming from the input.
841| *
842| * Returns a pointer to the normalized value (dst) or NULL if no conversion
843| *         is needed.
844| */
845|static const xmlChar *
846|xmlAttrNormalizeSpace2(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, xmlChar *src, int *len)
847|{
848|    int i;
849|    int remove_head = 0;
850|    int need_realloc = 0;
851|    const xmlChar *cur;
852|
853|    if ((ctxt == NULL) || (src == NULL) || (len == NULL))
854|        return(NULL);
855|    i = *len;
856|    if (i <= 0)
857|        return(NULL);
858|
859|    cur = src;
860|    while (*cur == 0x20) {
861|        cur++;
862|	remove_head++;
863|    }
864|    while (*cur != 0) {
865|	if (*cur == 0x20) {
866|	    cur++;
867|	    if ((*cur == 0x20) || (*cur == 0)) {
868|	        need_realloc = 1;
869|		break;
870|	    }
871|	} else
872|	    cur++;
873|    }
874|    if (need_realloc) {
875|        xmlChar *ret;
876|
877|	ret = xmlStrndup(src + remove_head, i - remove_head + 1);
878|	if (ret == NULL) {
879|	    xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
880|	    return(NULL);
881|	}
882|	xmlAttrNormalizeSpace(ret, ret);
883|	*len = strlen((const char *)ret);
884|        return(ret);
885|    } else if (remove_head) {
886|        *len -= remove_head;
887|        memmove(src, src + remove_head, 1 + *len);

1539|/**

1552|static int
1553|xmlParserNsPush(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, const xmlHashedString *prefix,
1554|                const xmlHashedString *uri, void *saxData, int defAttr) {

1556|    xmlParserNsExtra *extra;

1567|
1568|    /*
1569|     * Default namespace and 'xml' namespace
1570|     */

1572|        oldIndex = ctxt->nsdb->defaultNsIndex;
1573|
1574|        if (oldIndex != INT_MAX) {
1575|            extra = &ctxt->nsdb->extra[oldIndex];
1576|
1577|            if (extra->elementId == ctxt->nsdb->elementId) {
1578|                if (defAttr == 0)

1584|                (uri->name == ctxt->nsTab[oldIndex * 2 + 1]))

1601|         */
1602|        if (extra->elementId == ctxt->nsdb->elementId) {
1603|            if (defAttr == 0)

1605|            return(0);
1606|        }
1607|
1608|        if ((ctxt->options & XML_PARSE_NSCLEAN) &&
1609|            (uri->name == ctxt->nsTab[bucket->index * 2 + 1]))
1610|            return(0);

1613|        goto populate_entry;
1614|    }
1615|
1616|    /*
1617|     * Insert new bucket
1618|     */
1619|
1620|    hashValue = prefix->hashValue;
1621|
1622|    /*
1623|     * Grow hash table, 50% fill factor
1624|     */

1626|        xmlParserNsBucket *newHash;
1627|        unsigned newSize, i, index;
1628|
1629|        if (ctxt->nsdb->hashSize > UINT_MAX / 2) {
1630|            xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
1631|            return(-1);
1632|        }
1633|        newSize = ctxt->nsdb->hashSize ? ctxt->nsdb->hashSize * 2 : 16;
1634|        newHash = xmlMalloc(newSize * sizeof(newHash[0]));
1635|        if (newHash == NULL) {
1636|            xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
1637|            return(-1);
1638|        }
1639|        memset(newHash, 0, newSize * sizeof(newHash[0]));
1640|
1641|        for (i = 0; i < ctxt->nsdb->hashSize; i++) {
1642|            unsigned hv = ctxt->nsdb->hash[i].hashValue;
1643|            unsigned newIndex;
1644|
1645|            if (hv == 0)

1647|            newIndex = hv & (newSize - 1);
1648|
1649|            while (newHash[newIndex].hashValue != 0) {

1653|            }

1655|            newHash[newIndex] = ctxt->nsdb->hash[i];
1656|        }

1658|        xmlFree(ctxt->nsdb->hash);
1659|        ctxt->nsdb->hash = newHash;

1692|    extra->elementId = ctxt->nsdb->elementId;
1693|    extra->oldIndex = oldIndex;

1695|    ctxt->nsNr++;

4898|    size_t size = XML_PARSER_BUFFER_SIZE;

4900|    size_t maxLength = (ctxt->options & XML_PARSE_HUGE) ?
4901|                       XML_MAX_HUGE_LENGTH :
4902|                       XML_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH;

4904|    const xmlChar *in;
4905|    size_t nbchar = 0;
4906|    int ccol;
4907|    int inputid;

4909|    /*
4910|     * Check that there is a comment right here.
4911|     */

4913|        return;

4932|		in++;
4933|	    } while (*in == 0xA);
4934|	}

4936|        ccol = ctxt->input->col;
4937|	while (((*in > '-') && (*in <= 0x7F)) ||
4938|	       ((*in >= 0x20) && (*in < '-')) ||
4939|	       (*in == 0x09)) {
4940|		    in++;
4941|		    ccol++;
4942|	}

4944|	if (*in == 0xA) {
4945|	    do {
4946|		ctxt->input->line++; ctxt->input->col = 1;
4947|		in++;
4948|	    } while (*in == 0xA);
4949|	    goto get_more;
4950|	}
4951|	nbchar = in - ctxt->input->cur;
4952|	/*
4953|	 * save current set of data
4954|	 */
4955|	if (nbchar > 0) {
4956|            if (buf == NULL) {
4957|                if ((*in == '-') && (in[1] == '-'))
4958|                    size = nbchar + 1;
4959|                else

4964|                    return;
4965|                }
4966|                len = 0;
4967|            } else if (len + nbchar + 1 >= size) {
4968|                xmlChar *new_buf;
4969|                size  += len + nbchar + XML_PARSER_BUFFER_SIZE;
4970|                new_buf = (xmlChar *) xmlRealloc(buf, size);
4971|                if (new_buf == NULL) {
4972|                    xmlFree (buf);
4973|                    xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
4974|                    return;
4975|                }
4976|                buf = new_buf;

4984|                         "Comment too big found", NULL);

4990|	    in++;
4991|	    ctxt->input->line++; ctxt->input->col = 1;
4992|	}
4993|	if (*in == 0xD) {
4994|	    in++;
4995|	    if (*in == 0xA) {

6711|/**
6712| * xmlParseConditionalSections
6713| * @ctxt:  an XML parser context
6714| *
6715| * Parse a conditional section. Always consumes '<!['.
6716| *
6717| * [61] conditionalSect ::= includeSect | ignoreSect
6718| * [62] includeSect ::= '<![' S? 'INCLUDE' S? '[' extSubsetDecl ']]>'
6719| * [63] ignoreSect ::= '<![' S? 'IGNORE' S? '[' ignoreSectContents* ']]>'
6720| * [64] ignoreSectContents ::= Ignore ('<![' ignoreSectContents ']]>' Ignore)*
6721| * [65] Ignore ::= Char* - (Char* ('<![' | ']]>') Char*)
6722| */
6723|
6724|static void
6725|xmlParseConditionalSections(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) {
6726|    int *inputIds = NULL;
6727|    size_t inputIdsSize = 0;
6728|    size_t depth = 0;
6729|
6730|    while (PARSER_STOPPED(ctxt) == 0) {
6731|        if ((RAW == '<') && (NXT(1) == '!') && (NXT(2) == '[')) {
6732|            int id = ctxt->input->id;
6733|
6734|            SKIP(3);
6735|            SKIP_BLANKS;
6736|
6737|            if (CMP7(CUR_PTR, 'I', 'N', 'C', 'L', 'U', 'D', 'E')) {
6738|                SKIP(7);
6739|                SKIP_BLANKS;
6740|                if (RAW != '[') {
6741|                    xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_INVALID, NULL);
6742|                    xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
6743|                    goto error;
6744|                }
6745|                if (ctxt->input->id != id) {
6746|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
6747|                                   "All markup of the conditional section is"
6748|                                   " not in the same entity\n");
6749|                }
6750|                NEXT;
6751|
6752|                if (inputIdsSize <= depth) {
6753|                    int *tmp;
6754|
6755|                    inputIdsSize = (inputIdsSize == 0 ? 4 : inputIdsSize * 2);
6756|                    tmp = (int *) xmlRealloc(inputIds,
6757|                            inputIdsSize * sizeof(int));
6758|                    if (tmp == NULL) {
6759|                        xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
6760|                        goto error;
6761|                    }
6762|                    inputIds = tmp;
6763|                }
6764|                inputIds[depth] = id;
6765|                depth++;
6766|            } else if (CMP6(CUR_PTR, 'I', 'G', 'N', 'O', 'R', 'E')) {
6767|                size_t ignoreDepth = 0;
6768|
6769|                SKIP(6);
6770|                SKIP_BLANKS;
6771|                if (RAW != '[') {
6772|                    xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_INVALID, NULL);
6773|                    xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
6774|                    goto error;
6775|                }
6776|                if (ctxt->input->id != id) {
6777|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
6778|                                   "All markup of the conditional section is"
6779|                                   " not in the same entity\n");
6780|                }
6781|                NEXT;
6782|
6783|                while (PARSER_STOPPED(ctxt) == 0) {
6784|                    if (RAW == 0) {
6785|                        xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_NOT_FINISHED, NULL);
6786|                        goto error;
6787|                    }
6788|                    if ((RAW == '<') && (NXT(1) == '!') && (NXT(2) == '[')) {
6789|                        SKIP(3);
6790|                        ignoreDepth++;
6791|                        /* Check for integer overflow */
6792|                        if (ignoreDepth == 0) {
6793|                            xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
6794|                            goto error;
6795|                        }
6796|                    } else if ((RAW == ']') && (NXT(1) == ']') &&
6797|                               (NXT(2) == '>')) {
6798|                        SKIP(3);
6799|                        if (ignoreDepth == 0)
6800|                            break;
6801|                        ignoreDepth--;
6802|                    } else {
6803|                        NEXT;
6804|                    }
6805|                }
6806|
6807|                if (ctxt->input->id != id) {
6808|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
6809|                                   "All markup of the conditional section is"
6810|                                   " not in the same entity\n");
6811|                }
6812|            } else {
6813|                xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_INVALID_KEYWORD, NULL);
6814|                xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
6815|                goto error;
6816|            }
6817|        } else if ((depth > 0) &&
6818|                   (RAW == ']') && (NXT(1) == ']') && (NXT(2) == '>')) {
6819|            depth--;
6820|            if (ctxt->input->id != inputIds[depth]) {
6821|                xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
6822|                               "All markup of the conditional section is not"
6823|                               " in the same entity\n");
6824|            }
6825|            SKIP(3);
6826|        } else if ((RAW == '<') && ((NXT(1) == '!') || (NXT(1) == '?'))) {
6827|            xmlParseMarkupDecl(ctxt);
6828|        } else {
6829|            xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_EXT_SUBSET_NOT_FINISHED, NULL);
6830|            xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
6831|            goto error;
6832|        }
6833|
6834|        if (depth == 0)
6835|            break;
6836|
6837|        SKIP_BLANKS;
6838|        SHRINK;
6839|        GROW;
6840|    }
6841|
6842|error:
6843|    xmlFree(inputIds);

6855| *                     NotationDecl | PI | Comment

6859| * markup declarations. That is to say, if either the first character
6860| * or the last character of a markup declaration (markupdecl above) is
6861| * contained in the replacement text for a parameter-entity reference,
6862| * both must be contained in the same replacement text.

6864| * [ WFC: PEs in Internal Subset ]
6865| * In the internal DTD subset, parameter-entity references can occur
6866| * only where markup declarations can occur, not within markup declarations.
6867| * (This does not apply to references that occur in external parameter
6868| * entities or to the external subset.)

6871|xmlParseMarkupDecl(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) {
6872|    GROW;
6873|    if (CUR == '<') {

6876|	        case 'E':
6877|		    if (NXT(3) == 'L')
6878|			xmlParseElementDecl(ctxt);
6879|		    else if (NXT(3) == 'N')
6880|			xmlParseEntityDecl(ctxt);
6881|                    else
6882|                        SKIP(2);
6883|		    break;
6884|	        case 'A':
6885|		    xmlParseAttributeListDecl(ctxt);
6886|		    break;
6887|	        case 'N':
6888|		    xmlParseNotationDecl(ctxt);
6889|		    break;
6890|	        case '-':
6891|		    xmlParseComment(ctxt);
6892|		    break;

11225|/**
11226| * xmlParseLookupInternalSubset:
11227| * @ctxt:  an XML parser context
11228| *
11229| * Check whether there's enough data in the input buffer to finish parsing
11230| * the internal subset.
11231| */
11232|static int
11233|xmlParseLookupInternalSubset(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) {
11234|    /*
11235|     * Sorry, but progressive parsing of the internal subset is not
11236|     * supported. We first check that the full content of the internal
11237|     * subset is available and parsing is launched only at that point.
11238|     * Internal subset ends with "']' S? '>'" in an unescaped section and
11239|     * not in a ']]>' sequence which are conditional sections.
11240|     */
11241|    const xmlChar *cur, *start;
11242|    const xmlChar *end = ctxt->input->end;
11243|    int state = ctxt->endCheckState;
11244|    size_t index;
11245|
11246|    if (ctxt->checkIndex == 0) {
11247|        cur = ctxt->input->cur + 1;
11248|    } else {
11249|        cur = ctxt->input->cur + ctxt->checkIndex;
11250|    }
11251|    start = cur;
11252|
11253|    while (cur < end) {
11254|        if (state == '-') {
11255|            if ((*cur == '-') &&
11256|                (cur[1] == '-') &&
11257|                (cur[2] == '>')) {
11258|                state = 0;
11259|                cur += 3;
11260|                start = cur;
11261|                continue;
11262|            }
11263|        }
11264|        else if (state == ']') {
11265|            if (*cur == '>') {
11266|                ctxt->checkIndex = 0;
11267|                ctxt->endCheckState = 0;
11268|                return(1);
11269|            }
11270|            if (IS_BLANK_CH(*cur)) {
11271|                state = ' ';
11272|            } else if (*cur != ']') {
11273|                state = 0;
11274|                start = cur;
11275|                continue;
11276|            }
11277|        }
11278|        else if (state == ' ') {
11279|            if (*cur == '>') {
11280|                ctxt->checkIndex = 0;
11281|                ctxt->endCheckState = 0;
11282|                return(1);
11283|            }
11284|            if (!IS_BLANK_CH(*cur)) {
11285|                state = 0;
11286|                start = cur;
11287|                continue;
11288|            }
11289|        }
11290|        else if (state != 0) {
11291|            if (*cur == state) {
11292|                state = 0;
11293|                start = cur + 1;
11294|            }
11295|        }
11296|        else if (*cur == '<') {
11297|            if ((cur[1] == '!') &&
11298|                (cur[2] == '-') &&
11299|                (cur[3] == '-')) {
11300|                state = '-';
11301|                cur += 4;
11302|                /* Don't treat <!--> as comment */
11303|                start = cur;
11304|                continue;
11305|            }
11306|        }
11307|        else if ((*cur == '"') || (*cur == '\'') || (*cur == ']')) {
11308|            state = *cur;
11309|        }
11310|
11311|        cur++;
11312|    }

11314|    /*
11315|     * Rescan the three last characters to detect "<!--" and "-->"
11316|     * split across chunks.
11317|     */
11318|    if ((state == 0) || (state == '-')) {
11319|        if (cur - start < 3)
11320|            cur = start;
11321|        else
11322|            cur -= 3;
11323|    }
11324|    index = cur - ctxt->input->cur;
11325|    if (index > LONG_MAX) {
11326|        ctxt->checkIndex = 0;
11327|        ctxt->endCheckState = 0;
11328|        return(1);
11329|    }
11330|    ctxt->checkIndex = index;
11331|    ctxt->endCheckState = state;
11332|    return(0);
